note: These tasks are correct against the corpus, but chik check cannot grade them today. Measured with a binary built from the CLI stack (feat/234-chik-convert c933d5c2 plus jabdori/chik-errors). The first pass scored 14/30; eight of the failures were the task's own expected answers, not the product, and were fixed. The remaining eight are product behavior.

tasks.04_project_storage: chik check rejects storage in project.chik: the .chik to YAML step writes storage under generation, and the compiler reads it at the top level.
tasks.05_project_vault: chik check rejects vault in project.chik for the same reason: the .chik to YAML step writes it where the compiler does not read it.
tasks.07_api_id_input: chik check rejects a nested output record: get() -> { post: { id: id } } fails with unknown field id.
tasks.09_api_nullable_list: chik check rejects the same nested output shape used by the corpus case api_object_list.
tasks.13_api_nested_record: chik check rejects a nested output record with unknown field title.
tasks.15_schema_table: The .chik to YAML step writes a table-level primary_key list as a mapping with an empty key, so YAML refuses the file before the compiler sees it.
tasks.25_types_record: chik check rejects a types block: the .chik to YAML step has no YAML form for it, so the corpus case types_block is refused too.
tasks.26_types_two: chik check rejects a types block for the same reason.
tasks.28_error_extensions: chik check ignores chik/extensions.chik: it is not one of the role files it reads, so the corpus case extensions_block_is_retired never reaches CHK0601.
